design_detail: Narrative review of methamphetamine clinical pharmacology: pharmacokinetics by route, pharmacodynamics, acute and chronic effects, toxicity.
can_establish: A synthesis of controlled human pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic data.
cannot_establish: Anything beyond its sources; not a systematic review.

analysis.effect_sizes: Half-life, bioavailability by route and onset times are reported in the review; a half-life of about 10 h was noted when this card was drafted from the abstract and has not been checked against the full text, and no value from this review is used in any claim (Kish, 2008, gives about 11 h for smoked, intranasal and intravenous use). Exact values and the primary sources they rest on: [to be extracted from PDF].

replication.where_it_stands: Widely used reference review; primary PK studies to be added as sources in their own right.

risk_of_bias.reasoning: Narrative; acceptable as a pointer to primary PK studies, which must be cited directly before publication.

editorial_corrections.reason: Written from the abstract on 2026-10-14 for the first prototype, with placeholders where the PDF is needed; a card written from an abstract alone cannot leave draft (METHODS §5.5; methods audit M33). It is rewritten from the full text when the PDF is saved.

disagreements.first_pass: Reports half-life about 10 h, bioavailability by route, onset times ([to be extracted from PDF] exact values and the primary sources they rest on).
disagreements.resolution: Applied by the editor after adjudication against the source: Review round 2 (group P, finding 2): the card printed an unchecked 10 h beside the claim's 11 h from another review. The card was drafted from the abstract (source_read), so the figure is labelled as such; the claim no longer cites this card for the half-life (its placeholder anchor removed). Placeholder kept: the card stays draft until the PDF is read.
